root_motivation: **Who:** the builder whose PR adds one host verb and a 40-line arm, and whose CI shard then dies with SIGABRT in a test about a different verb (run 326, `verbfwd_ac01_trigger_set_dotted_forwards`; runs 953 and 945, same class, 10-17); the operator who redrives those runs; the agent on prod whose forwarded calls carry the same frames in release builds.
user_persona: An agent that runs host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool}} once and reads the note on that tool's description in every later session; the same user's second client sees it too.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given mcphost main containing PR #413, When `scripts/gen-dispatch-table.sh --write` runs and then `--check` runs inside `regen-check`'s generator list, Then `src/dispatch_table.rs` exists with one sorted row per canonical dotted `host.*` verb of `mcphost contract dump` minus `tool_aliases`, each row naming `arm_<verb>`, `--check` exits 0 on a clean tree and 1 naming the stale file after any registry change without a regen.

Given the table and `host_tool_descriptors(&KindRegistry::with_builtin())`, When `fwdtab_ac02` compares the table's names with the registry's canonical dotted `host.*` names, Then the sets are equal; and given one descriptor temporarily removed from the registry in the test, Then the test fails naming that verb as table-only (and a removed row fails naming it as registry-only).

Given a forwarded `host.whoami` on a debug build, When `scripts/fwd-stack-measure.sh --frame dispatch_tenant_tool_inner` measures the dispatcher's poll frame after every arm body moved into its `arm_*` function returning `Pin<Box<dyn Future>>`, Then the frame is ≤ 65,536 B (was 454 K) and `dispatch_tenant_tool_inner` contains no `match name` arm bodies, only the pre-checks, the lookup, the call, and the `unknown_host_tool` fallthrough.

Given the same forwarded call, When the inline arms of `call_tool_inner`'s `match (auth, name)` for `host.quickstart`, `host.help.search`, `host.help.get`, `host.errors`, `host.feedback.*`, `host.call_trace`, `host.doctor` have moved into boxed helpers, Then `call_tool_inner`'s poll frame is ≤ 163,840 B (was 260–310 K) and `tests/verbfwd_ac0[1-7]*` plus the quickstart, help, errors and feedback suites pass unchanged.

Given the guard `verbfwd_ac08_forward_stack_budget` with its registry walk and `SHALLOW` list unchanged, When `scripts/fwd-stack-measure.sh all` binary-searches all 226 ids on the debug build, Then the maximum is ≤ 1,048,576 B, `FORWARD_STACK_BUDGET` equals that maximum + 25 % and is ≤ 1,310,720 B, its doc comment names the maximum, its ids and the date, and the guard passes at that budget.

Given 200 sequential `host.tool_call name="host.whoami"` calls against the in-process server, When `fwdtab_ac06` prints p50 and p95 on `origin/main` (with #413) and on the branch on the same host with the same `-j`, Then the branch p95 is ≤ 1.05 × the main p95 and both printed values appear in the PR body.

Given `cargo test --release` of the guard binary, When `scripts/fwd-stack-measure.sh --release test:host.trigger.set call:host.uptime.create call:host.table.chart` runs on `origin/main` (with #413) and on the branch, Then each id's release-profile minimum stack on the branch is ≤ its value on main and all six numbers appear in the PR body.

Given the PR with `FORWARD_STACK_BUDGET` ≤ 1,310,720 merged to main, When CI runs the core-suites shard that contains `suite_core_08` on the merge commit, Then that shard's log contains `verbfwd_ac08_forward_stack_budget::every_dotted_verb_forwards_within_the_stack_budget ... ok` and the shard is green (Live; evidence: `gh run view <merge-commit run> --log` of the `cargo test (core suites, shard N/M)` job containing that line)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (the merge commit's core-suites shard log must contain the verbfwd_ac08 line; no tests/fwdtab_ac08 file)

scope: src/notes.rs: host.note.put/list/delete over the notes/ prefix of tenant_state_kv; the tools/list description suffix.
src/handler.rs, src/protocol/frames.rs: tools, dispatch, list_changed on a tool-attached put/delete (keyed row allows list_changed).
src/plans.rs, src/retention.rs, src/db.rs: notes_max plan field; expired-note sweep.
contracts/, docs/, www/: regenerated tool contract, output schemas, docs.
non_goals: Notes attached to runs surfaced in host.runs.get (R6), attached_to in host.resume/welcome_back (R5), pin (R7); shared notebooks across tenants.

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the next session repeat a mistake the last one learned from?
five_whys_trace.a: The only write path is remember at signup; nothing pins a note to the tool it is about.
